edits.why: Target real native popover and ordinary/lazy content disclosure integration that production unit hosts cannot certify
edits.consequence: Adds eight bounded actual public pointer/keyboard checks, finite presentation traces, current logical aria/inert and reversal assertions, system Reduced Motion, and real project-manager DOM disposal. Uses no private app state, introduces no production behavior or new dependency, and releases diagnostic observers on failure.

edits.why: A representative menu does not certify the twelve actual native popup callers
edits.consequence: Adds ninth group: all 8 Design menus and Assets/Script/Graph/Animation callers, exact logical aria/inert/finite settle and fixed summary geometry, per-caller screenshots, viewport/surface hit samples plus every enabled control after normal scrolling. Records all geometry failures before failing the group; uses only summaries/public navigation, never create/delete actions or panel maximization. Preserves original eight assertions.

edits.why: Exercise the real minimum desktop window and interpret the new native top-layer clipping contract correctly
edits.consequence: Preserves all first eight1600x900 groups; runs the single all12 matrix at1024x640/DPR1/UIscale1 and records actual conditions, then restores1600x900 on success. Surface probes remain center/four edge midpoints3px inside, never corner curves. Records actual :popover-open/data-ui-popover-layer surfaces. Enabled-control clip intersections stop at a real active top-layer surface while retaining its own scroll clipping, because outer DOM ancestors no longer clip that native surface; actual viewport/five-point/control elementFromPoint checks remain strict. No extra matrix, threshold relaxation, private state or production edit.

validation.scope: Headless software browser when invoked; no private owner registry or physical GPU/OS latency claim

geometryCorrection.before: Immediate getBoundingClientRect forbade the separately required summary press spring
geometryCorrection.after: Assert immediate untransformed layout box and exact rendered position after finite settlement; retain real viewport/edge/control hit tests and raw before/open/stable state
geometryCorrection.consequence: Test correctly separates local press feedback from popup-induced layout displacement. No product source or real-data edits; no geometry waiver.
geometryCorrection.verification: Actual first failed report and two PNGs retained in cache; current9-group run must be repeated

reducedNativeCorrection.before: The test demanded exit-only inert/pointer-none even after Reduced Motion had completed native details collapse and restored authored styles
reducedNativeCorrection.after: Retained visible exits must be inert/pointer-none; already collapsed native content must fail actual hit testing. Popup aria/exit, latest target and finite cleanup remain strict.
reducedNativeCorrection.consequence: Test distinguishes native semantic collapse from retained animation content. Product source and data behavior are unchanged.
reducedNativeCorrection.verification: Second failed actual report/captures retained locally; repeat actual9-group check required

scrollBaselineCorrection.before: Captured trigger geometry before the helper intentionally scrolls and focuses the control
scrollBaselineCorrection.after: Prepare the same native scroll/focus position first, then compare before/open geometry with unchanged viewport conditions
scrollBaselineCorrection.consequence: Intentional scrolling is not popup-induced layout movement. Exact trigger geometry, actual five-point hit testing and enabled-control reachability remain required; no product state writes.

floatingGeometryCoverage.before: Native surface geometry omitted radius and four-way inset
floatingGeometryCoverage.after: Read all four computed corners/insets for each actual minimum-window menu; require desired minimum semantic geometry independently from source token names
floatingGeometryCoverage.consequence: Reject real local overrides or missing styling rather than assuming token changes took effect; viewport/hit/control checks remain strict
